staticGuide.title: Use static residential IPs
staticGuide.connectionDescription: Open the IP list to see the IP address, port, and expiry date. Select Copy on the IP's row to get the full connection details.
staticGuide.clientDescription: Enter the IP address, port, username, and password in the corresponding fields in your proxy client. To configure multiple IPs, select the available IPs and export them as TXT. Each line uses the format {format}.
staticGuide.renewalDescription: Select Renew on an IP's row, or select several IPs and choose Bulk renew. If you miss the renewal deadline, you'll need to buy a new IP.
